tickets.title: Expand one Task Run interface through a recoverable tracer path
tickets.verification_result: Recoverable external-seam tracer, forged Receipt, Intent drift and five pre-Authority outcome cases passed; the final DSH/Responses suite passed 64 tests.
tickets.what_to_build: Introduce one in-process Task Run execute interface with Open and Resume commands, then drive the complete repository Task Agent v2 tracer scenario through it while existing callers remain temporarily compatible.
acceptance_criteria: The only new external seam is execute_task_run; no persisted command schema or CLI parameter is added.
Open derives Task Authority and initial Binding from verified host inputs rather than accepting caller-defined Authority.
One external-seam test opens a Task Run, reads source, performs an Action, records a Receipt and Observation, creates a Patch Candidate, checks it, interrupts, resumes and completes.
Resume preserves run/request identity, cumulative resources and the exact current resume reference; the interrupted Effect executes once.

The completed result contains exactly one Run Outcome reference and one Evidence Bundle reference whose bound originals include Intent, Authority, Binding, Receipt, Observation, checkpoint, candidate and check facts.
Existing forged preimage, permission, Receipt and superseded checkpoint counterexamples remain green.
tickets.why: 为什么要有它：先用一条完整 tracer bullet 证明 interface 有 depth，再迁移生产 adapter，避免先造空 facade。

tickets.title: Migrate the normal DSH and pilot adapters to the Task Run seam
tickets.verification_result: Normal DSH Open and --advance-task Resume plus the frozen pilot child use the shared Task Run seam; 64 DSH/Responses, 85 pilot and the original tool-receipt recovery regression passed.
tickets.what_to_build: Route normal repository Task Run opening and recovery from both DSH and pilot through the new Task Run interface, while retaining each adapter's human-facing or batch-specific responsibilities.
acceptance_criteria: The normal DSH path calls the Task Run interface once and returns its Suspended or Completed result without a second public dispatch path.
The pilot adapter calls the same interface and aggregates only Run Outcome and Evidence Bundle references; it no longer sequences task preparation and command construction itself.
The task-advance interface no longer starts a missing v2 task; Open and Resume selection belongs to the Task Run module.
Normal DSH and pilot adapters pass authoritative outcome/evidence references; legacy internal dictionaries remain a separate follow-up under ADR-0003.
Existing routing, strategy-preparation and legacy continuation callers outside the approved six-module scope keep their current behavior and do not become a second normal DSH/pilot path.
Normal entry status, inspection commands, task identity and accumulated cost remain unchanged.
tickets.why: 为什么要有它：两个真实 adapter 必须证明 seam 的 leverage，迁移也必须保持现有产品行为。

tickets.title: Contract the replaced normal Task Run interfaces
tickets.completion_scope: Normal DSH and pilot Task Run paths in the approved six-module architecture scope.
completed_deletions: Normal DSH Task Agent v2 no longer uses the secondary dispatch interface.
Pilot no longer imports or directly sequences task preparation and product argv construction.
Pilot frozen Task Agent execution now invokes execute_task_run from the verified platform snapshot and aggregates only its references.
The v2 task-advance not-found branch no longer starts a Task Run and returns DSH_TASK_RUN_OPEN_REQUIRED; existing incomplete runs Resume through execute_task_run.
tickets.what_to_build: Delete every compatibility path replaced for the normal DSH/pilot Task Run use case, delete its interface-specific tests, and prove the single external seam in remote CI. Global legacy outcome consumer migration is tracked by the deferred follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: The secondary product-dispatch interface is deleted from the normal Task Agent v2 path.
Pilot direct task-preparation, command-construction, process-execution and run-result interpretation paths are deleted for Task Agent B/B+ runs.
The task-advance auto-start branch and normal-path direct recovery projection are deleted.
Normal DSH and pilot adapters no longer assemble or interpret a duplicate technical Run Outcome; only the Task Run owner seals their Run Outcome and Evidence Bundle.
Tests that only freeze deleted interfaces are removed after equivalent execute_task_run coverage exists.
Search confirms no approved-module normal caller bypasses execute_task_run.
Focused tests, affected regressions, Ruff, Standards review, Spec review and the complete remote CI workflow pass.
After CI is green, the architecture chain stops and T1, T2 and T3 are reselected.
tickets.why: 为什么要有它：正常路径的兼容接口必须删除才能完成 tracer bullet；范围外旧消费者保留为独立后续项，不能无限扩大当前架构事项。
